authority_boundary: Project-authored consistency checks over human-reviewed fields. A mismatch is a review flag, not proof of fraud, legal invalidity, documentary non-compliance, or bank refusal. Amendments, tolerances, aliases, and superseded documents must be represented explicitly before final interpretation.

rules.failure_path: Different currencies between the contract and commercial invoice can change the payable amount, settlement account, and foreign-exchange exposure.
rules.suggested_resolution: Confirm the governing contract currency and correct or formally amend the inconsistent document before presentation or settlement.

rules.failure_path: An unexplained contract-invoice amount difference can produce payment disputes, credit-document discrepancies, tax or customs inconsistencies, and incorrect financing needs.
rules.suggested_resolution: Reconcile quantity, unit price, partial shipment, freight, insurance, discount, tax, and any reviewed tolerance or amendment before relying on the invoice amount.

rules.failure_path: Different trade terms can create inconsistent allocations of delivery obligations, costs, insurance, and risk transfer.
rules.suggested_resolution: Confirm the governing trade term and align the invoice or record the later valid amendment.

rules.failure_path: Different Incoterms editions can create ambiguity about which version governs the transaction.
rules.suggested_resolution: Confirm the intended edition and make the contract and invoice references consistent.

rules.failure_path: Different named places or ports can change delivery completion, cost allocation, transport responsibility, and risk-transfer points.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the precise place, port, terminal, or address and align the documents or record an approved amendment.

rules.failure_path: Different seller identities can create payment, sanctions-screening, tax, title, and document-presentation problems.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the exact legal entity, registration details, approved trade name, and any assignment or amendment.

rules.failure_path: Different buyer identities can obscure the actual payment obligor and create credit, compliance, and recovery uncertainty.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the exact buyer legal entity and document any permitted affiliate, nominee, or amendment.

rules.failure_path: A contract-credit currency mismatch can leave the credit unable to settle the contracted obligation as expected.
rules.suggested_resolution: Request an amendment or document the agreed currency change before shipment and presentation.

rules.failure_path: An unexplained contract-credit amount difference can leave part of the sale unsecured or produce inconsistent presentation expectations.
rules.suggested_resolution: Reconcile partial shipment, quantity tolerance, price adjustment, charges, and the credit's reviewed tolerance or request an amendment.

rules.failure_path: If the contractual seller and credit beneficiary differ without a reviewed assignment or structure, the intended exporter may not be entitled to draw under the credit.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the beneficiary legal entity and obtain an amendment or documented assignment structure before relying on the credit.

rules.failure_path: A different applicant may indicate an affiliate, financing party, or mistaken obligor and requires explicit confirmation.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the applicant's relationship to the contractual buyer and document any acceptable third-party applicant arrangement.

rules.field_label: Contract shipment date versus L/C latest shipment date
rules.failure_path: A contractual shipment date after the credit's latest shipment date makes the current timetable inconsistent and may prevent a complying shipment under the credit.
rules.suggested_resolution: Align the shipment schedule and credit deadline through an agreed amendment before production or shipment commitment.

rules.failure_path: A commercial invoice in a different currency from the credit can create a documentary and settlement inconsistency.
rules.suggested_resolution: Correct the invoice or amend the credit after bank review before presentation.

rules.failure_path: An invoice amount outside the reviewed credit tolerance may not be fully drawable and can create a presentation discrepancy.
rules.suggested_resolution: Apply only explicitly reviewed credit tolerance, partial-shipment, or amendment terms and reconcile the invoice before presentation.

rules.failure_path: A different invoice seller and credit beneficiary can prevent the presented invoice from evidencing the beneficiary's sale as expected.
rules.suggested_resolution: Verify the legal entity and any assignment or transferable-credit structure with the bank before presentation.

rules.failure_path: A different invoice buyer and credit applicant may reflect an affiliate structure or an incorrect invoice addressee and requires review.
rules.suggested_resolution: Confirm the required invoice addressee and applicant relationship before presentation.
